2) Marissa: share high-level RTO/RPO numbers and redacted IR runbook items where appropriate — Marissa will follow up separately

If helpful, we can schedule a short IR/BCP deep-dive next week with Marissa and your SecOps. Proposed times: Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the recap and quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) SOC 2: we require either a current SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 Type II summary plus an NDA if the full report is needed. If you can share the summary now that helps.
2) Breach notification: our policy expects initial notification to internal stakeholders within 48 hours of detection for incidents impacting payment/data flows. Can you confirm Redwood's committed timeline and escalation chain?
3) BCP/DR: we need RTO/RPO numbers for critical endpoints (API, auth, KV cache) and evidence of runbook testing/DR drills in the last 12 months.
4) We would like to kick off a vendor security questionnaire — attaching our standard questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf). Please confirm an owner for returning answers and an expected turnaround (we typically look for 7 business days).

If you can provide the summary and the attachments Marissa mentioned, we'll review and confirm the NDA / next steps. Thanks.

— Alice

Breach notification: our standard committed timeline is 72 hours for initial notification for hosted API customers. We'll surface the exact contact points in the formal evidence package.

BCP/DR evidence: attaching BCP-Executive-Summary.pdf (high-level RTO/RPO and DR test cadence). We have drill records and a redacted IR runbook; Marissa will share RTO/RPO specifics and the runbook excerpts that are suitable for sharing.

Proposed next step: call to review outstanding items and confirm NDA — Tue 2026-07-21 1:30pm PT / 4:30pm ET work for folks?

Thanks, Jordan

Hi Alice — looping in with the technical details you asked for. High level RTO/RPO and testing cadence below; happy to provide redacted logs under NDA.

- API endpoints (auth/generate): RTO = 4 hours (failover to cross-region redundant clusters), RPO = <=15 minutes (KV cache snapshot + cross-region replication)
- KV cache: RTO = 2 hours for cache warm-up w/ snapshot restore; RPO = 15 minutes
- Data retention & backups: backups retained 30 days; critical metrics stored for 365 days
- DR/drills: quarterly tabletop exercises, annual full failover test (last full test: 2026-03-12)
- Incident notification escalation: Primary IR POC: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai, +1 (415) 555-0199); Secondary: Rachel Kim (rachel.kim@redwood.ai)

I've attached a redacted runbook (IRP-Runbook.zip) with playbook summaries and escalation flow. For the vendor questionnaire Rachel will take point on tracking answers and will flag any items that require engineering input.

Marissa
